---
name: Feature request
about: Something the tool should do and does not
labels: enhancement
---

**The problem, not the solution.** What were you trying to do, and what got in
the way?

**What you did instead.** The workaround, if there is one. A workaround that
works is useful information: it bounds how much the feature is worth.

**Why it belongs in ctx.** This tool's cost is always-on context, so every
addition is paid for on every session by everyone. A change that helps one
workflow and costs all of them needs to say so.

**Anything you already know it must not break.** The done-gate, the trust
boundary and the `owns` model have each been the thing an otherwise good idea
would have quietly undermined.
